commonMistakesTr: 'under' ile 'below' karıştırılır: bir şeyin tam altında ve örtülü olma durumunda genelde 'under' kullanılır.

senses.label: below something
senses.definitionEn: in a lower position than something, or covered by it

examples.en: The cat is sleeping under the bed.
I found my keys under a pile of papers.
examples.tr: Anahtarlarımı bir kâğıt yığınının altında buldum.

examples.en: Children under twelve can enter the museum for free.
examples.tr: On iki yaşın altındaki çocuklar müzeye ücretsiz girebilir.

examples.en: She works well under pressure.

commonMistakesTr: 'Bir su' derken 'a water' demek yerine 'a glass/bottle of water' denir.
grammarNoteTr: Sayılamaz isim: much water, some water.

senses.label: liquid
senses.definitionEn: the clear liquid that falls as rain and that people and animals drink

examples.en: Can I have a glass of water, please?
examples.tr: Bir bardak su alabilir miyim, lütfen?
examples.noteTr: 'water' sayılamaz: a water değil, a glass of water.

examples.en: You should drink more water on hot days.
examples.tr: Sıcak günlerde daha fazla su içmelisin.

examples.en: The water in the lake was too cold for swimming.
examples.tr: Göldeki su yüzmek için fazla soğuktu.

senses.label: part of a building
senses.definitionEn: a part of a building with its own walls, floor and ceiling

examples.en: My room is small but very bright.
We booked a hotel room near the beach.
examples.tr: Plaja yakın bir otel odası ayırttık.

examples.en: The meeting room is on the third floor.

senses.label: space
senses.definitionEn: enough empty space for someone or something

examples.en: Is there room for one more person in the car?
examples.tr: Arabada bir kişilik daha yer var mı?

examples.en: Please make room for the new boxes.

grammarNoteTr: write – wrote – written; write to someone: birine yazmak.

senses.label: put words on paper or screen
senses.definitionEn: to make letters or words on paper or a screen

examples.en: Please write your name at the top of the page.
examples.tr: Lütfen adını sayfanın en üstüne yaz.

examples.en: She wrote three books before she was thirty.
examples.tr: Otuz yaşından önce üç kitap yazdı.

examples.en: Have you written the report yet?
I'm writing an email to my teacher.

senses.label: female parent
senses.definitionEn: a woman who has a child

examples.en: My mother works as a nurse.
She became a mother at the age of twenty-five.
Turkish is my mother tongue.

senses.label: part of a place
senses.definitionEn: a particular part of a city, country or space

examples.en: They live in a quiet area outside the city.
examples.tr: Şehrin dışında sakin bir bölgede yaşıyorlar.

examples.en: Smoking is not allowed in this area.
Are there any good restaurants in the area?
examples.tr: Bu civarda iyi restoran var mı?
examples.noteTr: in the area: bu civarda, buralarda.

senses.label: subject or activity
senses.definitionEn: a subject or range of activity

examples.en: Her main area of research is climate science.
Customer service is an area where we need to improve.
examples.tr: Müşteri hizmetleri, gelişmemiz gereken bir alan.

senses.label: of a whole country
senses.definitionEn: relating to a whole country rather than one part of it

examples.en: The national team won the match last night.
examples.tr: Millî takım dün gece maçı kazandı.

examples.en: Tomorrow is a national holiday, so the banks are closed.
examples.tr: Yarın ulusal bayram, bu yüzden bankalar kapalı.

examples.en: The news was reported in the national press.

commonMistakesTr: 'moneys' veya 'many money' denmez; doğrusu 'much money' ya da 'a lot of money'.
grammarNoteTr: Sayılamaz isim; fiil tekil: The money is on the table.

senses.label: coins and notes
senses.definitionEn: coins or banknotes that you use to buy things

examples.en: I don't have much money this month.
examples.noteTr: Sayılamaz: much money, not many moneys.

examples.en: She is saving money for a new laptop.
examples.tr: Yeni bir dizüstü bilgisayar için para biriktiriyor.

examples.en: How much money did you spend on the trip?

senses.label: description of events
senses.definitionEn: a description of events, real or imagined, told to entertain or inform

examples.en: My grandfather tells great stories about his childhood.
examples.tr: Dedem çocukluğu hakkında harika hikâyeler anlatır.

examples.en: The film is based on a true story.
Can you read me a bedtime story?
examples.tr: Bana bir uyku masalı okur musun?

senses.label: not old
senses.definitionEn: having lived for only a short time

examples.en: My parents met when they were very young.
This park is popular with young families.
examples.tr: Bu park genç aileler arasında popüler.

examples.en: She started playing the piano at a young age.
examples.noteTr: at a young age: küçük yaşta.

senses.label: something true
senses.definitionEn: something that is known to be true

examples.en: It is a fact that the earth goes around the sun.
examples.tr: Dünyanın güneşin etrafında döndüğü bir gerçektir.

examples.en: I thought the test was easy; in fact, it was very hard.
examples.tr: Sınavın kolay olduğunu düşündüm; aslında çok zordu.

examples.en: We need to check the facts before we publish the article.
examples.tr: Makaleyi yayınlamadan önce gerçekleri kontrol etmeliyiz.

commonMistakesTr: 'in next month' yanlıştır; 'next month' tek başına kullanılır.

senses.label: part of a year
senses.definitionEn: one of the twelve periods that a year is divided into

examples.en: We are moving to a new flat next month.
examples.tr: Gelecek ay yeni bir daireye taşınıyoruz.

examples.en: I go to the dentist once every six months.
Which month is your birthday in?

commonMistakesTr: 'different than' yerine sınavlarda genelde 'different from' tercih edilir; 'different of' yanlıştır.

senses.label: not the same
senses.definitionEn: not the same as another person or thing

examples.en: My sister is very different from me.
Let's try a different way to solve the problem.
examples.tr: Sorunu çözmek için farklı bir yol deneyelim.

examples.en: People from different countries came to the festival.

commonMistakesTr: 'a lot of' yazarken 'alot' bitişik yazılmaz.

senses.label: large amount
senses.definitionEn: a large number or amount of something

examples.en: There are a lot of people at the bus stop.
Thanks a lot for your help!
He has changed a lot since school.
We have lots of time before the train leaves.
examples.tr: Tren kalkmadan önce bolca vaktimiz var.

commonMistakesTr: 'Ders çalışmak' için 'work' değil 'study' kullanılır.

senses.label: learn
senses.definitionEn: to spend time learning about a subject

examples.en: I need to study for my English exam.
examples.noteTr: study for an exam: sınava çalışmak.

examples.en: She studied law at university.
Are you studying or working at the moment?
examples.tr: Şu anda okuyor musun yoksa çalışıyor musun?

senses.label: body part
senses.definitionEn: one of the two parts of the face that you see with

examples.en: She has big brown eyes.
Close your eyes and make a wish.
examples.tr: Gözlerini kapat ve bir dilek tut.

examples.en: Can you keep an eye on my bag for a minute?
examples.tr: Bir dakika çantama göz kulak olur musun?
examples.noteTr: keep an eye on: göz kulak olmak.

commonMistakesTr: 'job' sayılabilir (a job), 'work' genelde sayılamaz: 'a work' yerine 'a job' denir.

senses.label: paid work
senses.definitionEn: the regular work that a person does to earn money

examples.en: He got a new job at a software company.
examples.tr: Bir yazılım şirketinde yeni bir iş buldu.

examples.en: I'm looking for a part-time job.
You did a great job on this project!

senses.label: unit of language
senses.definitionEn: a single unit of language that has a meaning

examples.en: What does this word mean?
I learn ten new words every day.
examples.tr: Her gün on yeni kelime öğreniyorum.

examples.en: In other words, we need more time.
examples.tr: Başka bir deyişle, daha fazla zamana ihtiyacımız var.
examples.noteTr: in other words: başka bir deyişle.

commonMistakesTr: 'Despite' gibi isimle değil, cümleyle kullanılır: 'though the rain' değil, 'though it rained'.

senses.label: despite the fact
senses.definitionEn: used to introduce a fact that makes the main statement surprising

examples.en: Though it was raining, we went for a walk.
She came to work even though she felt tired.
He talks as though he knows everything.

senses.label: however (end of sentence)
senses.definitionEn: used at the end of a sentence to add a contrast

examples.en: The hotel was expensive. The view was amazing, though.
examples.tr: Otel pahalıydı. Manzara yine de muhteşemdi.
examples.noteTr: Konuşmada cümle sonunda 'yine de' anlamı verir.

examples.en: I don't really like jazz. This song is nice, though.
examples.tr: Cazı pek sevmem. Bu şarkı yine de güzel.

commonMistakesTr: Yazımı sık karıştırılır: 'bussiness' değil 'business'.

senses.label: buying and selling / company
senses.definitionEn: the activity of buying and selling, or a company that does this

examples.en: My uncle runs a small business in Izmir.
examples.tr: Amcam İzmir'de küçük bir işletme işletiyor.
examples.noteTr: run a business: iş yeri işletmek.

examples.en: She is going to Berlin on a business trip.
Business has been slow this year.

senses.label: someone's concern
senses.definitionEn: something that concerns only a certain person

examples.en: Where I go is none of your business.
examples.noteTr: none of your business: seni ilgilendirmez.

examples.en: Mind your own business, please.

senses.label: problem or topic
senses.definitionEn: an important subject or problem that people discuss

examples.en: Climate change is a serious global issue.
examples.tr: İklim değişikliği ciddi bir küresel sorun.

examples.en: We had some technical issues during the call.
examples.tr: Görüşme sırasında bazı teknik sorunlar yaşadık.

examples.en: What's the main issue here?

senses.label: left/right part or edge
senses.definitionEn: one of the two parts on the left or right of something, or an edge

examples.en: The bank is on the left side of the street.
examples.noteTr: on the left/right side: sol/sağ tarafta.

examples.en: They walked side by side along the river.
Please write on one side of the paper only.
examples.tr: Lütfen kâğıdın yalnızca bir yüzüne yazın.

senses.label: group in an argument
senses.definitionEn: one person or group in a fight, game or argument

examples.en: Whose side are you on?
Both sides agreed to stop the argument.
examples.tr: İki taraf da tartışmayı bitirmeyi kabul etti.

commonMistakesTr: 'kind' sıfat olarak 'nazik' de demektir; 'tür' anlamındaki isimle karıştırılmamalı.

senses.label: type
senses.definitionEn: a group of things that are similar to each other

examples.en: What kind of music do you like?
examples.noteTr: what kind of + isim: ne tür.

examples.en: The shop sells all kinds of fruit.
I'm kind of tired today.

commonMistakesTr: 'forty' (40) yazarken 'u' yoktur: 'fourty' yanlıştır.

senses.label: number 4
senses.definitionEn: the number 4

examples.en: My parents have four children.
The shop closes at four o'clock.
I've been to London four times.

senses.label: top of the body
senses.definitionEn: the part of the body above the neck

examples.en: I hit my head on the door.
She shook her head and said no.
examples.tr: Başını iki yana salladı ve hayır dedi.

examples.en: Put a hat on your head; it's cold outside.

senses.label: leader
senses.definitionEn: the person in charge of a group or organization

examples.en: She is the head of the marketing department.
The head teacher wants to see you.

commonMistakesTr: Olumlu cümlede 'It is far' yerine çoğu zaman 'It is a long way' daha doğaldır.

senses.label: a long distance
senses.definitionEn: at or to a great distance

examples.en: Is the station far from here?
We didn't walk very far because it was raining.
examples.tr: Yağmur yağdığı için çok uzağa yürümedik.

examples.en: So far, everything is going well.
examples.tr: Şimdiye kadar her şey yolunda gidiyor.

senses.label: colour
senses.definitionEn: having the darkest colour, like the sky at night

examples.en: She wore a black dress to the party.
I'd like a black coffee, please.
The old photos are in black and white.

senses.label: great length or time
senses.definitionEn: measuring a great distance from one end to the other, or lasting a lot of time

examples.en: She has long dark hair.
It was a long day at work.
How long does it take to get to the airport?

commonMistakesTr: Olumsuzda 'both' değil 'neither' kullanılır: 'Both of us don't' yerine 'Neither of us...'.

senses.label: the two together
senses.definitionEn: used to mean two people or things together

examples.en: Both my brothers live in Ankara.
examples.tr: İki erkek kardeşim de Ankara'da yaşıyor.

examples.en: She speaks both English and German.
examples.noteTr: both A and B: hem A hem B.

examples.en: We both like Italian food.

commonMistakesTr: 'a little' (biraz) ile 'little' (çok az, yetersiz) anlamca farklıdır.

senses.label: small
senses.definitionEn: small in size or young

examples.en: They live in a little house by the sea.
examples.tr: Deniz kenarında küçük bir evde yaşıyorlar.

examples.en: My little brother is six years old.
The baby was holding a little toy bear.
examples.tr: Bebek küçük bir oyuncak ayı tutuyordu.

senses.label: a small amount
senses.definitionEn: a small amount of something

examples.en: Can I have a little sugar in my tea?
There is very little time left.

commonMistakesTr: 'Eve gitmek' için 'go to house' değil 'go home' denir.

senses.label: building to live in
senses.definitionEn: a building where people live, usually one family

examples.en: They bought a house with a big garden.
Come to my house after school.
examples.noteTr: my house: bizim ev, benim evim.

examples.en: We are cleaning the house this weekend.

senses.label: agreement
senses.definitionEn: used to agree or to give a positive answer

examples.en: Yes, I'd love to come to the party.
Did she say yes to your offer?
examples.noteTr: say yes: evet demek, kabul etmek.

examples.en: Please answer yes or no.
examples.tr: Lütfen evet ya da hayır diye cevap verin.

commonMistakesTr: 'for' süre için, 'since' başlangıç noktası için: 'since three years' yanlış, 'for three years' doğrudur.

senses.label: from a past time
senses.definitionEn: from a time in the past until now

examples.en: I have lived here since 2018.
examples.noteTr: since + başlangıç zamanı; present perfect ile.

examples.en: We haven't seen each other since the summer.
She has worked here ever since she left school.

senses.label: because
senses.definitionEn: because; as

examples.en: Since it's raining, let's stay inside.
I'll make dinner since you cooked yesterday.
examples.tr: Dün sen yemek yaptığın için akşam yemeğini ben yapacağım.

commonMistakesTr: 'provide someone something' yerine 'provide someone with something' denir.
grammarNoteTr: provide something for someone / provide someone with something

senses.label: give or supply
senses.definitionEn: to give someone something they need

examples.en: The hotel provides free breakfast for all guests.
examples.tr: Otel tüm misafirlere ücretsiz kahvaltı sağlıyor.

examples.en: Can you provide more details about the job?
examples.tr: İş hakkında daha fazla ayrıntı verebilir misiniz?

examples.en: The school provided us with new laptops.
examples.tr: Okul bize yeni dizüstü bilgisayarlar sağladı.

senses.label: help for customers / system
senses.definitionEn: work done for customers, or a system that supplies something people need

examples.en: The service in this restaurant is very fast.
Please call customer service if you have a problem.
The city has a good bus service.
examples.tr: Şehrin iyi bir otobüs hizmeti var.

senses.label: in a circle / in many places
senses.definitionEn: in a circle or in many parts of a place

examples.en: We sat around the fire and sang songs.
She has travelled around the world.
Is there a supermarket around here?

senses.label: approximately
senses.definitionEn: about; near a number or time

examples.en: I'll be there around six o'clock.
The tickets cost around fifty dollars.

senses.label: person you like
senses.definitionEn: a person you know well and like

examples.en: She is my best friend from school.
It's easy to make friends in this city.
I'm meeting a friend for coffee later.
examples.tr: Sonra bir arkadaşla kahve içmeye buluşacağım.

commonMistakesTr: 'important for me' yerine duygusal önem için çoğu zaman 'important to me' denir.

senses.label: having great value
senses.definitionEn: having a big effect or value

examples.en: It's important to drink enough water.
I have an important meeting tomorrow.
Family is very important to me.

senses.label: male parent
senses.definitionEn: a man who has a child

examples.en: My father taught me how to ride a bike.
He became a father last year.
Her father is a teacher.

commonMistakesTr: 'Oturmak (ikamet etmek)' için 'sit' değil 'live' kullanılır.

senses.label: rest on a seat
senses.definitionEn: to be in a position where your weight is on your bottom, on a chair or the floor

examples.en: Please sit down and wait.
We sat by the window in the café.
Can I sit next to you?

senses.label: to or at a distance
senses.definitionEn: to or at a different place, or at a distance

examples.en: The beach is two kilometres away.
He walked away without saying goodbye.
My boss is away this week.

commonMistakesTr: 'until' süre bitişini, 'by' son tarihi gösterir: 'Finish it until Friday' değil 'by Friday'.

senses.label: up to a time
senses.definitionEn: up to a particular time or event

examples.en: The shop is open until nine.
Wait here until I come back.
examples.noteTr: until + şimdiki zaman: gelecek anlamı verir.

examples.en: I didn't know about it until yesterday.

senses.label: control
senses.definitionEn: the ability to control people or events

examples.en: The new party came to power in 2010.
Money gives some people too much power.
examples.tr: Para bazı insanlara fazla güç veriyor.

examples.en: She has the power to change the rules.

senses.label: energy
senses.definitionEn: energy, especially electricity, used to run machines

examples.en: There was a power cut last night.
The village gets its power from the wind.

commonMistakesTr: 'Saat kaç?' için 'What hour is it?' değil 'What time is it?' denir; 'a hour' yerine 'an hour'.

senses.label: 60 minutes
senses.definitionEn: a period of sixty minutes

examples.en: The film lasts two hours.
I'll be back in an hour.
Traffic is terrible during rush hour.

senses.label: activity with rules
senses.definitionEn: an activity or sport with rules that people play for fun or to win

examples.en: Let's play a board game tonight.
examples.tr: Bu akşam bir kutu oyunu oynayalım.

examples.en: My son spends hours playing video games.
Did you watch the game last night?
examples.noteTr: Amerikan İngilizcesinde maç için de 'game' denir.

commonMistakesTr: Sıklık zarfı 'be' fiilinden sonra gelir: 'She often is late' değil 'She is often late'.

senses.label: many times
senses.definitionEn: many times or regularly

examples.en: I often go swimming on Sundays.
examples.tr: Pazar günleri sık sık yüzmeye giderim.
examples.noteTr: Sıklık zarfı ana fiilden önce gelir.

examples.en: How often do you visit your parents?
It doesn't often snow here.

commonMistakesTr: Olumlu cümlede 'yet' yerine 'already' veya 'still' kullanılır.

senses.label: until now
senses.definitionEn: until now; used in negatives and questions

examples.en: I haven't finished my homework yet.
Have you seen the new film yet?
Is dinner ready yet? I'm really hungry.
examples.tr: Akşam yemeği hazır mı? Çok acıktım.

senses.label: but
senses.definitionEn: but; despite this

examples.en: The plan is simple, yet very effective.
He studied hard, yet he failed the test.
examples.tr: Çok çalıştı ama yine de sınavdan kaldı.

senses.label: long thin mark / row
senses.definitionEn: a long thin mark, or a row of people or things

examples.en: Draw a straight line under the title.
examples.tr: Başlığın altına düz bir çizgi çiz.

examples.en: We waited in line for twenty minutes.
examples.noteTr: wait in line (AmE) = queue (BrE): sırada beklemek.

examples.en: Read the first line of the poem.

senses.label: relating to politics
senses.definitionEn: relating to the government or public affairs of a country

examples.en: There are three main political parties in the country.
examples.tr: Ülkede üç ana siyasi parti var.

examples.en: He doesn't like talking about political topics.
The country is going through a political crisis.

commonMistakesTr: 'at the end' (bir şeyin sonunda) ile 'in the end' (sonunda, nihayet) karıştırılır.

senses.label: final part
senses.definitionEn: the final part of something

examples.en: The office is at the end of the corridor.
I'll pay you back at the end of the month.
examples.tr: Sana parayı ay sonunda geri öderim.

examples.en: In the end, we decided to stay at home.

commonMistakesTr: İki kişi/şey için 'among' değil 'between' kullanılır.

senses.label: in a group of
senses.definitionEn: in the middle of or included in a group of three or more

examples.en: The house is hidden among the trees.
This app is popular among teenagers.
We shared the cake among the five of us.
examples.noteTr: İkiden fazlası için 'among', iki kişi için 'between'.

senses.label: at any time
senses.definitionEn: at any time, often used in questions and negatives

examples.en: Have you ever been to Japan?
examples.noteTr: Have you ever...?: Hiç ... yaptın mı?

examples.en: This is the best pizza I've ever eaten.
examples.tr: Bu, şimdiye kadar yediğim en iyi pizza.

examples.en: Nobody ever tells me anything.

senses.label: be on your feet
senses.definitionEn: to be in an upright position on your feet

examples.en: Please stand up when the teacher comes in.
We stood at the bus stop for half an hour.
examples.tr: Yarım saat otobüs durağında ayakta bekledik.

examples.en: There were no seats, so I had to stand.
examples.tr: Koltuk yoktu, bu yüzden ayakta durmak zorunda kaldım.

senses.label: tolerate
senses.definitionEn: to accept or bear something unpleasant (usually with can't)

examples.en: I can't stand people who are always late.
She couldn't stand the noise any longer.

senses.label: not good
senses.definitionEn: not good, pleasant or of high quality

examples.en: I have some bad news for you.
I'm really bad at maths.
The weather was bad, so we stayed home.
examples.tr: Hava kötüydü, bu yüzden evde kaldık.

examples.en: How was the film? Not bad!

commonMistakesTr: 'lose' (kaybetmek, /luːz/) ile 'loose' (gevşek, bol, /luːs/) karıştırılır.

senses.label: not have any more / not win
senses.definitionEn: to no longer have something, or to fail to win

examples.en: I lost my phone on the bus.
Our team lost the match by two goals.
Don't lose this ticket; you'll need it later.
examples.tr: Bu bileti kaybetme; sonra lazım olacak.

examples.en: He wants to lose some weight before summer.
examples.tr: Yazdan önce biraz kilo vermek istiyor.

senses.label: person in a group
senses.definitionEn: a person who belongs to a group or organization

examples.en: She is a member of the school choir.
All family members came to the wedding.
New members get a free T-shirt.
examples.tr: Yeni üyeler ücretsiz bir tişört alıyor.

senses.label: rules of a country
senses.definitionEn: a rule made by a government, or the system of such rules

examples.en: Driving without a licence is against the law.
The government passed a new law on recycling.
examples.tr: Hükümet geri dönüşümle ilgili yeni bir yasa çıkardı.

examples.en: My cousin is studying law in Istanbul.

commonMistakesTr: 'meet with someone' yerine günlük dilde genelde 'meet someone' denir.

senses.label: come together
senses.definitionEn: to come together with someone, by plan or by chance, or to see them for the first time

examples.en: Hi, I'm Elif. Nice to meet you!
examples.tr: Merhaba, ben Elif. Tanıştığımıza memnun oldum!

examples.en: Let's meet in front of the cinema at seven.
I met my wife at university.

senses.label: reach a requirement
senses.definitionEn: to do or reach what is needed

examples.en: We worked late to meet the deadline.
examples.tr: Teslim tarihine yetişmek için geç saate kadar çalıştık.

examples.en: The product doesn't meet our standards.

senses.label: vehicle
senses.definitionEn: a road vehicle with an engine and four wheels

examples.en: We went to the beach by car.
examples.noteTr: by car: arabayla ('by the car' denmez).

examples.en: Where did you park the car?
She bought her first car last year.

senses.label: large town
senses.definitionEn: a large and important town

examples.en: Istanbul is the biggest city in Turkey.
The hotel is in the city centre.
Do you prefer city life or village life?
examples.tr: Şehir hayatını mı köy hayatını mı tercih edersin?

commonMistakesTr: 'Çoğu insan' için 'almost people' değil 'most people' veya 'almost all people' denir.

senses.label: nearly
senses.definitionEn: nearly but not completely

examples.en: Dinner is almost ready, so please wash your hands.
examples.tr: Akşam yemeği neredeyse hazır, lütfen ellerini yıka.

examples.en: I almost missed the train this morning.
Almost everyone in the class passed the exam.
examples.tr: Sınıftaki hemen hemen herkes sınavı geçti.

senses.label: keep doing
senses.definitionEn: to keep doing something without stopping

examples.en: Please continue reading from page ten.
examples.tr: Lütfen onuncu sayfadan okumaya devam edin.

examples.en: The rain continued all night.
She wants to continue her studies abroad.
examples.tr: Eğitimine yurt dışında devam etmek istiyor.

senses.label: prepare or arrange
senses.definitionEn: to put something in position or make it ready to work

examples.en: Can you set the table for dinner?
examples.tr: Akşam yemeği için sofrayı kurar mısın?

examples.en: I set my alarm for six o'clock.
It's a good idea to set clear goals.
examples.tr: Net hedefler belirlemek iyi bir fikir.

senses.label: sun goes down
senses.definitionEn: when the sun goes down in the evening

examples.en: The sun sets early in winter.
We watched the sun set over the sea.

commonMistakesTr: 'later' (sonra) ile 'latter' (ikincisi) ve 'after' karıştırılır: 'see you after' değil 'see you later'.

senses.label: after now
senses.definitionEn: at a time after the present or after another time

examples.en: I have to go now. See you later!
I'm busy now; can I call you back later?
examples.tr: Şu an meşgulüm; seni sonra arayabilir miyim?

examples.en: Three years later, they got married.

senses.label: what someone is called
senses.definitionEn: the word or words that a person or thing is called

examples.en: Excuse me, what is your name?
Please write your first name and last name.
I can never remember the name of that street.

commonMistakesTr: 'fifth' (beşinci) yazımında 'v' değil 'f' vardır: 'fiveth' yanlıştır.

senses.label: number 5
senses.definitionEn: the number 5

examples.en: I have five cousins on my mother's side.
The meeting starts at five.
She ran five kilometres this morning.

senses.label: one time
senses.definitionEn: one time only

examples.en: I go to the gym once a week.
examples.tr: Haftada bir kez spor salonuna gidiyorum.

examples.en: I've only met him once.
Read the text once before answering.
examples.tr: Cevaplamadan önce metni bir kez oku.

senses.label: as soon as / in the past
senses.definitionEn: as soon as; or at some time in the past

examples.en: Once you finish, you can go home.
This building was once a school.

senses.label: colour
senses.definitionEn: having the colour of snow or milk

examples.en: He was wearing a white shirt.
The walls of my room are white.
Her hair turned white when she was sixty.

senses.label: smallest amount
senses.definitionEn: less than all others in amount or degree

examples.en: You should sleep at least seven hours a night.
examples.tr: Gecede en az yedi saat uyumalısın.
examples.noteTr: at least: en az, hiç değilse.

examples.en: This is the least expensive phone in the shop.
At least nobody was hurt.

senses.label: leader
senses.definitionEn: the leader of a country or of an organization

examples.en: The president gave a speech on television.
She was elected president of the student club.
examples.noteTr: elect someone president: birini başkan seçmek.

examples.en: Who was the first president of the club?

commonMistakesTr: 'Birine bir şey öğretmek' için 'learn' değil 'teach' kullanılır: 'He learned me' yanlış, 'He taught me' doğrudur.

senses.label: gain knowledge or skill
senses.definitionEn: to get knowledge or a new skill

examples.en: I'm learning English with an app.
She learned to swim when she was five.
examples.noteTr: learn to + fiil / learn how to + fiil.

examples.en: We all learn from our mistakes.

senses.label: existing / true
senses.definitionEn: existing in fact, not imagined or false

examples.en: Is that a real diamond?
The film is based on real events.
In real life, he's very shy.

senses.label: become or make different
senses.definitionEn: to become different, or to make something different

examples.en: The city has changed a lot in ten years.
I changed my mind; I'll have tea instead.
examples.tr: Fikrimi değiştirdim; onun yerine çay alacağım.

examples.en: Can I change my seat?
We have to change trains in Ankara.

senses.label: group working together
senses.definitionEn: a group of people who play or work together

examples.en: Which football team do you support?
examples.noteTr: support a team: bir takımı tutmak.

examples.en: Our team finished the project on time.
We work well as a team.

senses.label: 60 seconds
senses.definitionEn: a period of sixty seconds

examples.en: The bus comes every ten minutes.
examples.tr: Otobüs her on dakikada bir geliyor.

examples.en: Wait a minute, I'm coming!
She always does her homework at the last minute.

senses.label: better than all others
senses.definitionEn: of the highest quality; better than all others

examples.en: This is the best pizza in town.
Who is your best friend?
Don't worry, just do your best.
examples.tr: Merak etme, sadece elinden geleni yap.
examples.noteTr: do your best: elinden geleni yapmak.

senses.label: more than two
senses.definitionEn: more than two but not very many

examples.en: I've called him several times today.
Several students were absent this morning.
Several of my friends live abroad.

senses.label: thought or plan
senses.definitionEn: a thought or plan about what to do

examples.en: Going to the beach is a great idea!
I have no idea where my keys are.
examples.tr: Anahtarlarımın nerede olduğu hakkında hiçbir fikrim yok.
examples.noteTr: I have no idea: Hiçbir fikrim yok.

examples.en: Whose idea was it to come here?

senses.label: child (informal)
senses.definitionEn: a child (informal)

examples.en: The kids are playing in the garden.
Do you have any kids?
As a kid, I loved cartoons.

senses.label: physical form
senses.definitionEn: the whole physical structure of a person or animal

examples.en: Exercise is good for your body and mind.
examples.tr: Egzersiz vücudun ve zihnin için iyidir.

examples.en: The human body is mostly water.
His body language showed that he was nervous.

commonMistakesTr: 'informations' veya 'an information' denmez; 'some information' ya da 'a piece of information' kullanılır.

senses.label: facts
senses.definitionEn: facts or details about something

examples.en: For more information, visit our website.
examples.tr: Daha fazla bilgi için web sitemizi ziyaret edin.

examples.en: Can you give me some information about the course?
examples.tr: Bana kurs hakkında biraz bilgi verebilir misiniz?

examples.en: That's a useful piece of information.

commonMistakesTr: Çift olumsuz yapılmaz: 'I don't know nothing' yanlış, 'I know nothing' veya 'I don't know anything' doğrudur.

senses.label: not anything
senses.definitionEn: not anything; no thing

examples.en: There's nothing in the fridge.
I have nothing to do this weekend.
examples.tr: Bu hafta sonu yapacak hiçbir şeyim yok.

examples.en: She said nothing about the problem.

commonMistakesTr: 'ago' süreden sonra gelir: 'ago two years' değil 'two years ago'; present perfect ile kullanılmaz.

senses.label: before now
senses.definitionEn: before the present time

examples.en: I moved to Izmir two years ago.
She left a few minutes ago.
How long ago did you start learning English?
examples.tr: İngilizce öğrenmeye ne kadar zaman önce başladın?

senses.label: be in charge / guide
senses.definitionEn: to be in charge of a group, or to show the way

examples.en: She leads a team of ten engineers.
examples.tr: On kişilik bir mühendis ekibini yönetiyor.

examples.en: The guide led us through the old town.
Who will lead the meeting tomorrow?

senses.label: cause
senses.definitionEn: to cause something to happen

examples.en: Too much stress can lead to health problems.
examples.tr: Fazla stres sağlık sorunlarına yol açabilir.

examples.en: This road leads to the beach.

senses.label: relating to society/people
senses.definitionEn: relating to society or to meeting and spending time with other people

examples.en: I spend too much time on social media.
examples.tr: Sosyal medyada çok fazla zaman geçiriyorum.

examples.en: Since I started this job, I have no social life.
examples.tr: Bu işe başladığımdan beri sosyal hayatım yok.

examples.en: Poverty is a serious social problem.

commonMistakesTr: Durum fiilidir; 'I am understanding' yerine 'I understand' denir.

senses.label: know the meaning
senses.definitionEn: to know the meaning of something or why something happens

examples.en: I don't understand this question.
Do you understand what I mean?
She finally understood why he was angry.
examples.tr: Sonunda onun neden kızgın olduğunu anladı.

commonMistakesTr: 'whether' (-ip -mediği) ile 'weather' (hava durumu) aynı okunur ama farklı yazılır.

senses.label: if (choice)
senses.definitionEn: used to talk about a choice between two possibilities

examples.en: I don't know whether he is coming or not.
She asked me whether I liked the food.
We will go, whether it rains or not.
examples.tr: Yağmur yağsa da yağmasa da gideceğiz.

commonMistakesTr: TV veya maç için 'look' ya da 'see' değil genelde 'watch' kullanılır.

senses.label: look at for some time
senses.definitionEn: to look at something for a period of time

examples.en: We watched a film last night.
My dad watches the news every evening.
Watch out! There's a car coming!

senses.label: with each other
senses.definitionEn: with each other; in the same place or at the same time

examples.en: We went to school together.
Let's work together on this project.
Mix the eggs and sugar together.

senses.label: go after / obey
senses.definitionEn: to go behind someone, or to do what rules or instructions say

examples.en: Follow me, I'll show you the way.
examples.tr: Beni takip et, sana yolu göstereyim.

examples.en: Please follow the instructions carefully.
I don't follow you. Can you explain again?

commonMistakesTr: 'parents' akraba demek değildir; akrabalar için 'relatives' kullanılır.

senses.label: mother or father
senses.definitionEn: a mother or a father

examples.en: My parents live in a small town.
examples.tr: Annemle babam küçük bir kasabada yaşıyor.

examples.en: Every parent wants the best for their child.
examples.tr: Her ebeveyn çocuğu için en iyisini ister.

examples.en: The school sent a letter to all parents.
examples.tr: Okul tüm velilere bir mektup gönderdi.

commonMistakesTr: 'stop smoking' (sigarayı bırakmak) ile 'stop to smoke' (sigara içmek için durmak) farklıdır.

senses.label: not continue
senses.definitionEn: to not continue doing something, or to make something end

examples.en: Please stop talking and listen.
The bus stopped in front of the school.
He stopped smoking two years ago.
We stopped to buy some water.

senses.label: front of the head
senses.definitionEn: the front part of the head where the eyes, nose and mouth are

examples.en: Wash your face before you go to bed.
She had a big smile on her face.
It's better to talk face to face.

senses.label: any thing
senses.definitionEn: used in questions and negatives to mean a thing of any kind

examples.en: Do you need anything from the shop?
examples.tr: Dükkândan bir şeye ihtiyacın var mı?

examples.en: I didn't eat anything this morning.
You can order anything you want.

senses.label: make something new
senses.definitionEn: to make something new or cause it to exist

examples.en: You need to create an account first.
The new factory will create hundreds of jobs.
She created a beautiful garden from nothing.

senses.label: for everyone
senses.definitionEn: open to or used by all people, or connected with the government

examples.en: I usually use public transport to get to work.
examples.tr: İşe gitmek için genelde toplu taşıma kullanırım.

examples.en: Smoking is banned in public places.
examples.tr: Kamuya açık yerlerde sigara içmek yasak.

examples.en: He doesn't like speaking in public.

senses.label: before now
senses.definitionEn: before now or before the time expected

examples.en: No food for me, thanks. I've already eaten.
examples.tr: Bana yemek yok, teşekkürler. Ben zaten yedim.
examples.noteTr: Genelde present perfect ile: have already + V3.

examples.en: Is it ten o'clock already?
When we arrived, the film had already started.

commonMistakesTr: 'speak English' doğru, 'speak in English' sadece 'İngilizce dilinde' vurgusunda kullanılır; 'talk English' yanlıştır.

senses.label: say words / use a language
senses.definitionEn: to say words, or to be able to use a language

examples.en: Do you speak any other languages?
Could I speak to the manager, please?
She spoke very quietly, so I couldn't hear her.
examples.tr: Çok sessiz konuştu, bu yüzden onu duyamadım.

commonMistakesTr: 'others' tek başına isim yerine geçer; isimden önce 'other' kullanılır: 'others people' değil 'other people'.

senses.label: other people or things
senses.definitionEn: other people or things, not the ones already mentioned

examples.en: Some students walked home; others took the bus.
examples.tr: Bazı öğrenciler eve yürüdü; diğerleri otobüse bindi.

examples.en: Where are the others? Are they still at the café?
It feels good to help others.
examples.tr: Başkalarına yardım etmek insana iyi gelir.

senses.label: look at and understand words
senses.definitionEn: to look at written words and understand them

examples.en: I read for half an hour before bed.
examples.tr: Yatmadan önce yarım saat kitap okurum.

examples.en: Have you read this book?
examples.noteTr: read – read – read: yazılışı aynı, geçmişte /red/ okunur.

examples.en: My daughter is reading a story about dragons.
examples.tr: Kızım ejderhalar hakkında bir hikâye okuyor.
